items.question: Which physical marks and garland adorn the described form?
premises: The form is holeless and rounded.
The form may also be long.
The form is endowed with a left garland.
items.inference: The described form is solid and rounded or long, and bears a left garland.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the form is not stated in this isolated verse.
Grammatical gender and case agreement remain partly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Holeless, rounded or long, endowed with a left garland.
